passages.section: What is a Subsidized Study Abroad Program?
passages.text: In 1981, Hanyang University became the first university in Korea to offer a subsidized study aboard program. The program provides scholarships to Hanyang University graduates who wish to study abroad for their master's or doctoral programs. It produces a large number of talented professionals each year and plays a key role in various aspects of society. The university is always on the lookout for interested graduates. Specific application windows and detailed selection requirements may be slightly modified each year, so please be sure to check the recruitment notice before applying (read online notices).
